provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: the Tours Mame 1922 window carries 'S' at this point where the 1962 does not; the Tours Mame 1922 reads 'xtérnz' where the 1962 prints 'aeternae:'; the Tours Mame 1922 reads 'futire.' where the 1962 prints 'futurae.'; recogniser damage in the Tours Mame 1922 text layer at this locus, not variant readings: Apostolis. for apostolo; UMPTUM, for sumptum; redemptidnis for redemptionis; quésumus; for quaesumus; Bartholomzo for bartholomaeo; Apdstolo for apostolo; vite for uitae; preséntis for praesentis; bare numeric tokens (printed folio / marginal numbers) dropped from the Tours Mame 1922 reading: 19, 28. 700; conclusion length was not collated: the 1962 prints 'Per Dominum.' and the witness abbreviates the same rubrical cue; one formula at two lengths, which is within the matched tolerance. Corroboration: Pustet Ratisbon 1862, nearest preceding printed-folio marker 516 at text-layer line 71280; text-layer lines 71370-71390 (char-level agreement 0.778 with the 1962 target).

propers.name: Postcommunion

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Historical source s-bartholomaei-apostoli/main/Postcommunion/all/1; strict. Complete Latin word sequence and actual ending equal under typography only. Cross-owner reuse requires entire literal canonical Latin equality including conclusion, punctuation, wraps and final LF, SHA256 c8d2b6b7ed383e5e1e90a79f4f0c32f3923aba9b9f6f0944b4de936a467ba6fe. Original target proof passage.catholic-church.missale-romanum.vatican-typica-1962.temporal-s-bartholomaei-apostoli-orations retained.
